[[File:Ebareebaveebeedee.jpg|thumb|right|upright|High Squibbian Law prevented the Squib king from using any of the junk hanging from his royal regalia.]]
'''High Squibbian Law''' was the traditional legal system of the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref> One of its strictures was that possession was nine-hundred-and-ninety-nine-one-thousandths of the law.<ref name="EOTJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> Sometime in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] or later,<ref name="date 1">''[[Echoes of the Jedi]]'' states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], an event that occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], the Squib [[Jiminaldo-mabbramsti]] cited this aspect of High Squibbian Law to support his claim of ownership over [[7-A39]], a [[Limb/Legends|legless]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that he and his crew had found, but which a group of [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]] also claimed under [[Ugorian Divine Law]].<ref name="EOTJ" /> By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="date 2">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']] takes place at some point after the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] destruction, which occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and before the assignment of [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], which occurred in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] according to ''The New Essential Chronology''.</ref> another aspect of High Squibbian Law mandated that the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Squib Polyanarchy]] could carry no possessions but the junk hanging from his regal outfit, yet he could use none of these items.<ref name="SH" />

==Behind the scenes==
High Squibbian Law first appeared in [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']], an adventure written by [[Brad Freeman]] and published in [[1989]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[West End Games]].<ref name="SH" />
